description: Agent Limits: submit a limit set (each limit with its amount and what it applies to: everything, one agent, named tasks, named merchants or counterparties, or both) and the work it governs (each kind of job with its merchant, a typical amount and its largest legitimate amount). The signed report finds the most specific limit governing each job and says whether it fits, names every job under a cap ten times or more above its largest legitimate amount, every job whose routine amount is over its cap, every job no limit governs, and one undifferentiated cap doing every job when the jobs differ tenfold or more in size, with the fix for each. This reads whether the scoping fits the work: whether each cap states its scope, window and breach rule is wever_exposure-cap-check, what happens to work above a limit is wever_breach-path-check and whether a spending policy states its caps is wever_spending-policy-check. A summary sample is wever_limit-scope-sample on https://weverlabs.com/mcp-free. Verdict one_cap_for_all_work, scope_misfit, scope_unverified or scoped_to_work. POST /api/limit-scope-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-limits-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-limits/.
